text:
sophia: Heads-up — planning to roll forward the catalog alias `aurora-lite` to `aurora-lite:2026-03-15-rc2` tomorrow 09:00 PST. Need owners for smoke, metrics watch, and rollback readiness. @chris @leo? :megaphone:
chris: I can own smoke at +5m (09:05). What exact checks do we want? latency + basic prompts?
katy: I can watch dashboards and toggle fallback. Thresholds: p95 > 250ms OR error rate > 0.5% -> fallback.
sophia: Yes. Minimal checklist: 1) latency p50/p95, 2) 3 prompt sanity (short/medium/long), 3) embedding unit checksum run, 4) cold-start sample to verify KV warming. Log folder: /mnt/ops/canary/aurora-lite/2512345678
leo: Rollback plan ready. Alias snapshot exists. Command to revert if needed: ```redwood catalog alias swap --name aurora-lite --to aurora-lite:2026-02-28-stable``` I'll be on call and can run it within 3m.
chris: For the prompt set, suggest: 
- "Summarize: <article>"
- "Translate: Hello world -> Spanish"
- "Longform: write 3-paragraph product note about batching"
I'll paste results to the canary thread.
sophia: One more: can we warm KV/cache for the canary tier before traffic? small prefix warm. @chris any script?
chris: Yup. Quick curl we use: ```curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/serve/warm -H 'Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_KEY' -d '{"model":"aurora-lite:2026-03-15-rc2","prefixes":["Hello","Summarize","Translate"]}'```
sophia: Perfect. ops note: we will allocate 10% traffic to canary for 15m then ramp if green. If any metric hits threshold within the 15m window we stop and rollback.
deploy-bot: scheduled deployment for aurora-lite:2026-03-15-rc2 by @sophia at 2026-03-18T09:00:00-08:00 (09:00 PST).
katy: I'll keep an eye on token-level cost and weird latency spikes. Ping me in thread if you see errors, I'll flip alias fallback. :white_check_mark: 
sophia: Thanks all — plan: warm 08:58 PST, deploy 09:00, smoke @09:05, observe until 09:20 then ramp to 50% at 09:25 if green. I'll post a final update here when done.
